messages:
sam: Quick hoptest summary for L4 vs T4 vs A10G — embeddings + small-chat. Ran microbench across eu-west1 / us-west2 / apac1. Posting config + topline numbers, then a quick callout on kernel/quant tradeoffs.

sam: Config we ran:
```
model: redwood-embed-768 / redwood-chat-small
quant: q4_0 (primary), int8 secondary
batch_sizes: emb {64,256}, chat {1,8,16}
seq_len: emb 128, chat 64
kernels: flash-attn-v2, triton-opt
regions: eu-west1, us-west2, apac1
metrics: p50/p95 latency (ms), tokens/s, cost estimate ($/1M tokens)
```

rui: Nice. Can you paste the raw numbers? especially p95 across regions — those drive our SLO.

sam: Raw condensed table (p50 / p95 latency ms) — embedding first, then small-chat. cost est = rough infra amortized (gpu-hour pricing + perf).
```
EMBEDDINGS (batch 256):
- L4 eu-west1: 22 / 46  |  tokens/s 18k  | cost ~$7.2 / 1M
- T4 us-west2: 30 / 70  |  tokens/s 12k  | cost ~$5.1 / 1M
- A10G apac1: 18 / 40  |  tokens/s 20k  | cost ~$9.0 / 1M

SMALL-CHAT (batch 8, seq 64):
- L4 eu-west1: 55 / 140 | tokens/s 1.8k | cost ~$18 / 1M
- T4 us-west2: 82 / 220 | tokens/s 1.2k | cost ~$12 / 1M
- A10G apac1: 40 / 95  | tokens/s 2.6k | cost ~$22 / 1M
```

anjali: Interesting — embeddings: L4 gives best latency/throughput for eu-west but cost per 1M favours T4 due to spot pricing. For chat, A10G dominates latency. p95 on L4 is decent but p95 variance on T4 is high.

anjali: Also saw that prefix/KV cache hit-rate changes the small-chat p95 a lot. If cache hit-rate <60% p95 jumps ~30-40ms on A10G; on T4 it's worse.

rui: Which kernel was used for each run? flash-attn-v2 vs triton-opt matters for small sequences.

sam: I used flash-attn-v2 on A10G and L4; triton-opt on T4 (default runtime selection). Flash gave ~15-25% p50 improvement on chat across A10G. On embeddings flash vs triton was ~5% diff.

cleo: We also did q4_0 vs int8 quick compare for chat: q4_0 saved ~25% tokens/s cost on L4/T4 but introduced occasional hallucination / slight score drop on our QA eval set (BLEU-like metric dropped ~1.8%). int8 kept quality but cost savings only ~10-12%.

sam: TL;DR recommendations from hoptest: 
- Embeddings: T4 with q4_0 for cost-sensitive batch workloads (batch >=128). Use eu-west waned to pick region by spot pricing.
- Small-chat (low-latency): A10G with flash-attn + int8 (or int8 hybrid) for best p95 and stable KV cache behavior.
- L4 is good middle ground if you want consistent latency across both workloads but cost is higher than T4 embeddings.

cleo: Capacity sizing note: aim to reserve 25-30% headroom above observed peak tokens/s for autoscale buffer. For canary/dedicated we size to target p95 <= 120ms for chat. That maps to approx 8 A10G-equivalent GPUs for our 10k QPS chat baseline (with batching knobs).

rui: Any follow-ups? I'd like a longer soak in eu-west on A10G with flash+int8 for 12 hrs and include the eval regression harness to quantify q4_0 vs int8 on chat examples.

sam: Agreed — scheduling 12h soak (eu-west1 A10G) + eval runs tomorrow. I'll also capture kernel traces and prefix cache hit-rate histogram.

infra-bot: packer: job-gpu-hoptest-1729876543 completed, artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/hoptest/1729876543/* :white_check_mark:

anjali: Nice. If the soak looks good we can propose: embeddings on reserved T4 pools, chat on mixed A10G dedicated with fallback to L4 (cheaper) for scale bursts. :thumbsup:

sam: Cool. I'll post the full CSV and perf plots after the soak. Thanks all.
